subject: WRITE statement
notes: kb/Work PB686 + PB523 LANDED - THE CONDITION WAS ALREADY MEASURED; ARM a)'s REPOSITIONING SENTENCE IS NOW MEASURED TOO, ON BOTH ORDERINGS. What this row was PARTIAL for was named exactly: arm a) does not stop at the condition, it also says 'the device is repositioned to the first line that may be written on the next logical page and the logical record is presented on that line', and for any file with a LINES AT TOP phrase that first writable line is past the top margin, which 13.18.34.4 GR4's discarded operand made unreachable - the counter landed right and the device did not. Both are now decided in one place: PositionOnLogicalPage computes the condition and calls BeginNextLogicalPage, which travels the rest of the current page (unwritten body lines plus the bottom margin, GR5), re-evaluates the operands (13.18.34.4 GR6 b) 3, 'before the device is positioned and after all positioning on the current page') and steps one line onto the next page, leaving the device on its line 1 with the new top margin still to materialize. Bytes_TopAndBottomMarginsAreLinesOfTheLogicalPage pins the AFTER ordering ('the device is repositioned ... and the logical record is presented on that line' - the record after the wrap is on page-2 body line 1, physical line 11, not on the first line of the page and not on the line after the old body); Bytes_OverflowWithBeforePhrase_PresentsThenRepositions pins the BEFORE ordering ('the logical record is presented and the device is repositioned'), which was previously exercised only by nist:SQ201M and now has a spec-derived fixture. The a)/b) DISCRIMINATION and the c == page size boundary are unchanged and stay adjudicated in docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 4 ('DETERMINATION - the 14.9.51.4 GR26 a)/b) boundary at LINAGE-COUNTER = page size'), pinned by conformance:cases/13.18.34-LINAGE/pb686_linage_gr26_boundary and its 85 twin on BOTH arms of the FOOTING dispatch. RESIDUE, deliberately not folded in here: GR27's choice between EC-I-O-EOP-OVERFLOW and EC-I-O-EOP is GR-14.9.51.4-27's row and the EC subsystem is a later slice.
